- **Visibility:** the brief goes to #strategic-random. Right now its members (you, Gideon and Nadia) are all in #inc-vtg-hartford and #strategic-pod, so the summary doesn't reveal anything new to them. If membership changes, I'll need to re-check before posting anything from the incident room.
